description: Explains a contract, official letter, tax assessment or terms-and-conditions document in plain language, clause by clause. Send the full text of the document. Returns every relevant clause with the original wording, a plain language version and why it matters, plus a short summary. It explains what the document says — it does not give legal advice, does not review the document and does not recommend a course of action. Takes 20 to 60 seconds. If it is still running when this call returns, use get_explanation with the returned analysis_id.

language.description: Language the explanation should be written in (ISO 639-1). Defaults to English. The document itself may be in any language.

text.description: The full text of the document to explain.

name: explain_document
title: Explain a contract or official letter
